alice: Quick postmortem follow-up: KV-cache mismatch under burst traffic. Need tests + owners so we don't regress again.

maya: Short list: 1) tiny prompt-based eval (CI-fast), 2) nightly load ramp to 8k for 10m, 3) local make target for devs, 4) chaos drill playbook.

sara: I'll add a focused prompt set (~10 prompts) that force prefix reuse. Will wire to eval-runner with `--strict-kv` to fail on divergence.

kevin: I'll add two perf jobs: a PR smoke (2k for 2m) and nightly (8k for 10m). Non-blocking nightly + auto-ticket on failure.

maya: Owners/dates: kevin -> perf jobs (due: 2026-04-05); sara -> prompts + make target (due: 2026-03-29); alice -> KV metrics + alert (due: 2026-03-27); maya -> chaos drill doc & schedule (due: 2026-04-07).

inc-bot: Reminder: add entries to postmortem tracker with labels `regression-test` and `chaos-drill`.

alice: Also add GH path-trigger: any PR touching `serving/kv*` runs the 2k smoke. Maya to own.

sara: Will keep prompts tiny and deterministic; add seed variants offline. Also `make kv-local-test` will run 30s at ~2k locally.

kevin: I'll link reproducer logs to INC-7423 and open the perf PR today.

alice: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem tracker with owners and due dates. We'll validate after the first drill. :thumbsup:
